references.text: Pharaoh dreams by the Nile – the direct context for the dream of the seven fat cows.
Pharaoh recounts to Joseph the dream of the seven fat and the seven lean cows.
Joseph interprets the seven fat cows as seven years of abundance and the seven lean cows as seven years of famine.
Joseph explains that there will be seven years of great abundance throughout Egypt, followed by seven years of famine.
Seven years of famine are also mentioned in connection with God's judgment, parallel to the seven years in Pharaoh's dream.
This verse completes the theological picture by introducing the contrast between abundance and scarcity, which is at the heart of Joseph's interpretation.
This verse links the two conflicting images together in an action that underscores the seriousness and prophetic power of the dream.
